cases.query: Find the spreadsheet called Spring Seed Orders in my files.
Put the residents’ committee meeting in my calendar for 7 pm next Thursday.
Remove the old fax number from the contact card for Northbridge Workshop.
What time is it in Edinburgh right now?
Zip the folder named Exhibition Photos 2025.
Work out the median of 18, 22, 22, 27 and 41.
Archive the email thread about venue insurance, and add ‘renew projector cover’ to my task list.
Move the Receipts folder into Accounts and mark the invoice email as unread.
List the open pull requests for the archive project, and sort these attendance totals from highest to lowest: 28, 31, 19, 26.
Find the latest version of the workshop safety guide and share that file with the organising team.
Locate the message from the venue about wheelchair access, then reply to it saying the side entrance will be staffed.
Make a folder called ‘Receipts to Claim’ and move the three attached scans into it.
Create a task called ‘Return library books’ for Friday afternoon, and take the books back to the library for me.
Find the invoice email from Greenbank Joinery and pay the £85 balance it mentions.
Add the new heating times from this note to my calendar, then set the boiler to follow them.
Rename the attached scan ‘Tenancy notice.pdf’ and decide whether the notice is legally valid.
Book a table for four at the Italian restaurant on the high street this Saturday evening.
Carry the parcel downstairs and leave it by the front door.
I can’t remember where I put the final poster—could you track it down?
That committee email from Monday—could you open it for me?
Could you bung the duplicate scans into a zip file?
Of the events I added this week, move the one whose title mentions the archive launch to the first Friday in October.
Would you mind letting everyone on the project know that tomorrow’s review has been postponed?
Once you’ve grouped these donations by month, tell me which month has the highest total: £12 in March, £18 in April, £9 in March and £7 in May.
Before deleting the folder called ‘Old Grant Applications’, ask me to confirm that exact deletion.
Share the private committee archive with the new treasurer only after the club secretary has approved that access.
Find the email about the broken projector, but don’t reply to it; just mark it as important.
Add the rehearsal to my calendar for 6 pm on Wednesday, but don’t send any invitations.
If the archive folder already contains a file named ‘Index.pdf’, update that file with the attached version; otherwise create a task reminding me to prepare the index.
Please undo only the change you made in your last turn.
Undo the change from your previous turn, then move the revised timetable into the Shared folder.
Switch on the workshop’s extraction fan.
